context:
Redshift Delta: Register Delta table in AWS Glue catalog, then create Redshift
Spectrum external table referencing the Glue table.  Requires IAM role with Glue
and S3 permissions.

BigQuery Delta: Create BigLake external table with Delta format.  Requires BigLake
connection resource and GCS bucket access.

Both implementations are cloud-specific and require careful credential/permission
handling.
description:
Redshift and BigQuery both support Delta Lake on the platform but their BenchBox
adapters only load parquet/CSV.  These platforms were removed from DELTA_CAPABILITY
in format_capabilities.py (commit 9be7d5b70) to prevent the fail-fast check from
passing when loading would fail.

Platform mechanisms:
- Redshift: Delta via Redshift Spectrum + AWS Lake Formation.  Requires Glue catalog
  integration to register Delta tables as external tables.
- BigQuery: Delta via BigLake external tables (GA since mid-2024).  Requires BigLake
  connection + external table definition pointing to GCS Delta directory.

Completed closure:
- BenchBox now uses mode-aware format selection so native/default flows remain
  conservative.
- BigQuery Delta is only advertised when the run includes the required BigLake
  connection configuration.
- Redshift Delta is only advertised when the run includes the required Spectrum/IAM
  configuration.
